ClientAddress.//: client -> Cloudflare -> Container Apps ingress -> app: the visitor is the second X-Forwarded-For entry from the right. Correct only while the origin accepts Cloudflare's ranges alone. ClientAddress__ForwardedHops overrides it.

HostAllowlist.//: The names the site answers to; anything else is a 400, except /healthz and /readyz (HostAllowlist.cs). The wildcard is the container app's own default domain, in case Cloudflare reaches the origin by that name: the shared ingress only routes this app's own FQDN here. localhost is for `make run`. Override with HostAllowlist__Hosts__0, __1, ...
